display_name: Radars of the regiment's control battery that feed the PU-12M
status: Library of radar TYPES (simcore/c2_sources.hpp, roadmap 7.1). A scenario's "c2.regiment" block places instances of them; the PU-12M's board then only holds the targets some radar of the list covers. Every number cited; the radars' heights are estimates.
notes: Coverage is the simplest honest model: a target is seen when it is within the radar's range and above its radar horizon, 4.12 (sqrt(antenna height) + sqrt(target height)) km. No clutter, terrain or blind cone; that is the EM layer's job.

radars.notes: The control battery's radar in the Soviet regiment (korovin_tiv_2010) and two of the NVA regiment's (flak11).

max_range_m.source: fm100_2_3 p. 5-138 (Flat Face, UHF, 250 km: the US Army's view in 1991); nato_radar_refs (P-19 instrumented range 260 km)

antenna_height_m.source: estimate (a truck- or trailer-mounted UHF early-warning antenna stands a few metres up)

switch_position.source: rwd_mb3 (pu12e: the PU-12M's primary source switch, its third position 1RL13 / 1RL134); the P-19 is the 1RL134 (p19_to: РЛС П-19)

iff_interrogator.source: p19_to (4.3.3: the ground interrogator 1L23-6 for Kremniy-2, Kremniy-2M and Parol-4, its replies on the indicators; 4.3.1: identification marks among the signals to the ASPD)

radars.notes: In the NVA regiment's headquarters battery (flak11).

max_range_m.source: fm100_2_3 p. 5-138 (Long Track, over 150 km: a lower bound)

switch_position.source: rwd_mb3 (pu12e: the PU-12M's primary source switch, its second position 1RL111 / 1RL128); the P-40 is the 1RL128 (sam3d: its index)

iff_interrogator.source: estimate (a 1980s Soviet surveillance radar worked with a ground interrogator, as the P-19 with the 1L23-6, p19_to; the P-40's own is not found)

radars.notes: The P-19's forerunner, a UHF radar for low fliers on a truck; in the dynamic campaign testbed on the capital's eastern heights.

max_range_m.source: rusarmy_p15_p19 (the P-15's instrumented range 10-160 km, its coverage to 6000 m)

antenna_height_m.source: estimate (a truck-mounted UHF antenna, lower than the P-19's mast)

switch_position.source: rwd_mb3 (pu12e: the PU-12M's primary source switch, its third position 1RL13 / 1RL134); the P-15 is the 1RL13 (sam3d: its index)

radars.notes: A VHF early-warning radar on two trucks; in the dynamic campaign testbed in the capital's northern allotments.

max_range_m.source: ru_wiki_p18 (180 km against a fighter at 10,000 m, 60 km at 500 m: after «Оружие России»)

antenna_height_m.source: estimate (the Yagi array on its mast above the antenna truck)
